info.title: signalme
info.description: A tiny command-line companion for Luxafor USB LED devices. Set your availability status, play expressive light signals, and automate your workplace presence without a GUI. Windows only.

commands.name: as
commands.description: Set a durable status, or play a temporary light signal

arguments.name: STATUS_OR_SIGNAL
arguments.description:
Durable status:    available (or free), busy, away,
do-not-disturb (or dnd)
Temporary signal:  happy, bored, desperate, ready,
warning, alerting
A temporary signal plays an animation and then
restores the durable status,
except 'ready', which announces availability and ends
on 'available'

commands.name: off
commands.description: Turn every LED off and forget the durable status

commands.name: status
commands.description: Print the durable status signalme last set
